title: Activity Feed
content: Create activity feed/timeline component. Container: vertical list with max-height and scroll. Item structure: avatar (small), content (flex-1), timestamp. Timeline line: vertical connecting line between items. Event types: different icons/colors for create, update, delete, comment. Content: user name (font-medium), action description. Relative timestamps: "2 minutes ago". Grouping: group by date with headers. Load more button or infinite scroll.

variants.simple: Create activity feed showing recent events with timestamps and user avatars.
variants.detailed: Create activity feed/timeline component. Container: vertical list with max-height and scroll. Item structure: avatar (small), content (flex-1), timestamp. Timeline line: vertical connecting line between items. Event types: different icons/colors for create, update, delete, comment. Content: user name (font-medium), action description. Relative timestamps: "2 minutes ago". Grouping: group by date with headers. Load more button or infinite scroll.
variants.advanced: Create activity feed/timeline component with real-time updates. Container: vertical list with max-height (max-h-96 or custom) and overflow-y-auto, custom scrollbar styling. Item structure: flex row with avatar (w-8 h-8 rounded-full) on left, content (flex-1) in middle, timestamp (text-xs text-gray-400) on right or below content. Timeline line: vertical connecting line between items using pseudo-elements (::before on item with absolute positioning, w-0.5 bg-gray-200) or left border on container. Event types: different icons with colored backgrounds (w-8 h-8 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center) replacing avatar - PlusCircle (green) for create, Edit (blue) for update, Trash (red) for delete, MessageCircle (purple) for comment, User (gray) for user actions. Content: user name (font-medium text-gray-900) as link, action description ("created a new project", "updated the status"), affected item as link (text-blue-600 hover:underline). Relative timestamps: use date-fns formatDistanceToNow or similar ("2 minutes ago", "Yesterday at 3:45 PM", "Jan 15"), show full date on hover with title attribute. Grouping: group by date with sticky date headers ("Today", "Yesterday", "January 15, 2024"). Load more: "Load more" button at bottom, loading state with spinner, or infinite scroll using IntersectionObserver. Filters: filter pills or dropdown to filter by event type or user. Mark as read: visual distinction for new vs seen items (bg-blue-50 for unread), dot indicator. Real-time: new items appear at top with highlight animation (bg-yellow-50 fade out), use WebSocket or polling. Empty state: "No recent activity" message with illustration. Click item: navigate to related content. Hover: show additional details or quick actions. Collapse long descriptions with "Show more". Dark mode support. Accessibility: list role, announce new items with aria-live.
